actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +8 к попаданию, досягаемость 10 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 16 (2к10+5) колющего урона.
actions.name: Bite

actions.desc: The dragon magically transforms into a Beast or Humanoid that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form, which is Dragon. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it or is borne by the new form (the dragon's choice). It reverts to its true form if it dies. In a new form, the dragon retains its HP, ability to speak, proficiencies, and INT, WIS, and CHA scores, as well as this bonus action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claw

actions.desc: The dragon exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 49 (9d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.desc: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Repulsion Breath, if available.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the dragon.

traits.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
traits.desc_ru: Может дышать как воздухом, так и водой.
traits.name: Amphibious

traits.desc: After the bronze dragon uses its Lightning Breath, its body begins recharging with lightning, pulling electricity from nearby creatures. While the dragon's Lightning Breath is unavailable, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, a creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

ru.description: Крупный дракон, мировоззрение: хаотично-злое. Класс доспеха: 18 (природный доспех). Хиты: 148. Скорость: ходьба 40 фт., полёт 80 фт., плавание 40 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 20, ЛОВ 16, ТЕЛ 24, ИНТ 14, МУД 18, ХАР 22. Иммунитет к урону: электричеством. Чувства: тёмное зрение 120 фт., пассивное Восприятие 14. Показатель опасности: 8. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 2, действий: 6.
ru.name: Молодой бронзовый дракон
